Spiced apple & cinnamon porridge

Warm porridge naturally sweetened with spiced apples and cinnamon. Cooking the apples down slightly releases their juices, flavoring the entire bowl. Best served immediately while the spices are most fragrant.

Prep
5 min
Cook
10-15 min
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

Estimated to serve 2 people as a comforting meal.

  • 1 cup (90.0 g) quick-cooking steel-cut or rolled oats
  • 1 cup (240.0 ml) water
  • 1 cup (240.0 ml) whole milk or unsweetened almond milk
  • 1 crisp sweet apple (such as Honeycrisp or Gala), diced
  • 1 tbsp unsalted butter or coconut oil
  • 1 tsp ground cinnamon
  • ⅛ tsp ground nutmeg
  • Pinch of fine sea salt
  • 2 tbsp pure maple syrup
  • 2 tbsp chopped toasted pecans or walnuts

Contains milk (butter/milk) and tree nuts (pecans) if used. Oats may contain cross-contact gluten unless certified gluten-free.

Method

01

Sauté spiced apples.

Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add diced apple and ½ tsp of the cinnamon. Cook for 3–4 minutes until apple starts to soften slightly at edges.

02

Cook the porridge.

Add oats to the saucepan and toast in the butter for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in water, milk, the remaining ½ tsp of cinnamon, nutmeg, and a pinch of salt. Stir well and bring to a gentle bubble.

03

Simmer until thick.

Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently. For quick-cooking oats, cook for 5 minutes. For rolled oats, cook for 10-12 minutes until tender and porridge is thick and creamy.

Look for: Thick and creamy, with the oats tender but not mushy.

04

Serve with toppings.

Ladle into serving bowls. Drizzle each with maple syrup and finish with chopped toasted pecans for crunch.

Serve with

Estimated to serve 2 people as a comforting meal.

One way to change it up

Swap diced pears for the apple. In summer, substitute fresh peaches or berries. For extra protein, swirl in a tablespoon of chia seeds or almond butter.

A small technique note

Gently cooking the diced apples in melted butter and cinnamon before simmering with the oats caramelizes the natural sugars and infuses the entire bowl with warm bakery aroma.

Storage & Prep ahead

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. Storage life depends on ingredient freshness and preparation.
